_doc: Committed, shared Claude Code settings for the NetSec repo. Two PreToolUse guards, both failing open. guard-main-commit.sh blocks `git commit` on the default branch so changes always land through a feature branch and a PR (CLAUDE.md section 2). guard-bulk-read.py refuses a whole-file read of anything over 800 lines and names the targeted alternative, so site.css and bios.json stop landing in the context whole. Personal, machine-local overrides belong in the gitignored .claude/settings.local.json.
